Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was driving home on a weekday afternoon when the car in front of me suddenly slowed, and I braked as firmly as I
could. The vehicle coming the other way drifted into my lane, and despite my efforts to steer clear, we made contact
nose to nose. Both cars were moving slowly, so the impact was mild, but my head snapped forward and back. I have
been the policyholder on this coverage for several years, and I am the person listed on the policy for the vehicle I was
driving. I got out of the car and spoke with the other driver and the responding officer. I have told the same account of
what happened to everyone who has asked, and I have kept the details consistent from the scene onward. The next
morning I woke with stiffness and soreness in my neck, which a doctor later diagnosed as a neck strain. I am
submitting this statement so that my claim can be reviewed.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
